Check if the backend is configured for TLS: kubectl get pod -n dojo-sec-mtls -l app=backend -o jsonpath='{.items[0].spec.containers[0].command}' — it should use nginx-tls.conf.
The backend serves HTTPS on port 443. Connect from the frontend pod: kubectl exec -n dojo-sec-mtls frontend -- curl -sk https://backend-svc/flag — the -s skips verbose, -k skips cert verification.
The flag is at the /flag endpoint on the backend over HTTPS. Run bash verify.sh to confirm TLS is set up and get the flag.
